persistence.receipts_and_references: additive tables in existing TrainingRepository SQLite database
persistence.backup_commit: canonical bounded envelope is put and read-verified in CAS, training receipt commits, then a separate immutable CAS commit proof is published from the exact committed receipt
persistence.crash_boundary: failed training receipt commit leaves only unauthoritative CAS envelope bytes; a committed receipt with missing commit proof can publish its exact proof on backup retry
persistence.retention_commit: verify every candidate backup before atomically pruning checkpoint metadata and payload rows
persistence.restore_commit: validate all bytes, schemas, model state, exact manifest and execution binding plus current dataset authority before atomically inserting a checkpoint/payload and advancing the worker fence

envelope.full_state: manifest, code/environment/base/dataset identities, exact execution binding, full model and optimizer state, cumulative cursor/usage, seed state and immutable checkpoint metadata
envelope.encoding: canonical UTF-8 JSON, sorted keys, compact separators, finite numbers, no raw corpus copy
envelope.integrity: verify canonical bytes, receipt SHA256, current CAS digest algorithm/address, tenant, trust context, logical ID and version on every read
envelope.operator_request: null when absent; otherwise exact existing governed_cli_request admission, canonical request/digest, UTC acquisition and expected dataset CAS version; same target table restored atomically without inventing missing rows
envelope.commit_proof: restore and retention require exact skeleton.training_checkpoint_backup_commit.v1 CAS proof at training-checkpoint-commit:<checkpoint SHA256>, version 1

compatibility.target: already registered run with exact manifest and exact execution binding; no automatic dataset registration or identity substitution
compatibility.corpus: caller supplies the exact registered materialized split for semantic cursor validation
compatibility.schemas: exact supported payload/binding pairs; existing trainer restore validators validate full model, optimizer and cursor state
compatibility.rollback: reject an archived checkpoint older than the latest durable target checkpoint
compatibility.fencing: clear all worker leases, advance epoch beyond current and archived epochs, set recovering, and pin the imported recovery checkpoint
compatibility.rights: dataset quality, training rights and exact dataset authority epoch remain mandatory
compatibility.registration_inputs: verify_backup reads complete validated manifest/binding from committed CAS backup without registering or changing training state

retention.policy: keep newest requested checkpoint count and all pinned active/recovery references; prune only verified backed-up checkpoints
retention.backup_receipts: preserved after training checkpoint pruning for exact re-import
retention.cas_deletion: unsupported; immutable storage authority is not bypassed by training retention
retention.reference_authority: running reference mutations require the current worker lease

failure_rules: missing, modified or unsupported CAS bytes fail before retention or restore writes
cross-tenant, trust-context, code, environment, dataset, base-model or execution binding substitution fails closed
partial backup/import/retention commits never leave authoritative partial state
stale workers cannot mutate protected references or continue imported work
re-import is idempotent and never rewinds a newer target checkpoint
retention never deletes the latest checkpoint or a pinned active/recovery checkpoint
scope_limitations: bounded native ngram, single-worker NumPy neural, and fixed 2-4 local process rank checkpoint formats
no new runtime owner or service
operational CAS commit proofs rely on trusted governed CAS writer authority; no cryptographic signature or resistance to an attacker controlling CAS publication is claimed
